Vessels to be registered and marked with number, burthen and indication of place of registry

SIND ACT NO
SIND ACT NO.I OF
1863. *
*For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B. G. G.,1862. Supplement, p. 422; for Report of the
Select Committee, see ibid, p. 588; and for Proceedings in Council see ibid,
pp. 583 and 797. The short title was given by the Sind Short Titles Act, 1921
(Sind 2 of 1921) which has been rep. by Sind Ordinance 5 of 1955, s. 5, Sch. I.
[THE INDUS VESSELS
ACT, 1863.]
[2nd February, 18663.]
An Act for the registry of
vessels *** *
* ** * on the River Indus.
**The
words "and Levy of pilotage-fees" omitted by Act 3 of 1942, s. 2.
1. Vessels
to be registered and marked with number, burthen and indication of place of
registry.----Every vessel plying on the river Indus and its tidal channels
within ***[Sind] shall be registered by an,
officer appointed for the purpose, who shall be called the Registrar of boats,
and every vessel so registered shall be marked or branded with a number, the
register ed burthen and a letter or letters indicating the place of registry.
***Subs. for the words, "the Province
of Bind" by W.P.A.O. 1964 Sch., Pt.IV-B(i).

Name, number, burthen, etc., to be registered

SIND ACT NO
SIND ACT NO.I OF
1863. *
*For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B. G. G.,1862. Supplement, p. 422; for Report of the
Select Committee, see ibid, p. 588; and for Proceedings in Council see ibid,
pp. 583 and 797. The short title was given by the Sind Short Titles Act, 1921
(Sind 2 of 1921) which has been rep. by Sind Ordinance 5 of 1955, s. 5, Sch. I.
[THE INDUS VESSELS
ACT, 1863.]
[2nd February, 18663.]
An Act for the registry of
vessels *** *
* ** * on the River Indus.
**The
words "and Levy of pilotage-fees" omitted by Act 3 of 1942, s. 2.
2. Name, number, burthen,
etc., to be registered.----The name and number and burthen of every vessel
plying as aforesaid, and the name of the owner thereof, shall be registered in
a book kept for that purpose by the Registrar of boats; and when ever any
change shall take place in the burthen of such vessel plying as aforesaid, or
in the name or names of the owner thereof, such vessel shall be again
registered.

infringement.----In case any vessel plying as aforesaid shall not be
registered, marked or branded, in all respects as hereinbefore directed, or
in case such vessel shall not be
furnished with a proper certifi cate of registry, or
in case the owner or person in
charge of such vessel shall not produce such certificate when required as
aforesaid, .
the owner or person in charge of
such vessel shall, on convic tion thereof before a Magistrate *[of the first class], be liable to a fine not
exceeding ten times the amount of the fees payable annually in respect of the
registry of such vessel, which fine, if not paid, may be recovered by sale of
such vessel, her furniture, ammunition, tackle and apparel.
*Subs.
